author: Open Source Contributors
description: A .NET 10.0 modular monolith template with Clean Architecture, DDD tactical patterns, CQRS (no MediatR), Minimal APIs, EF Core + Dapper, FluentValidation, Outbox pattern, YARP reverse proxy, JWT auth, Serilog, and more. Catalog module included as reference implementation.
name: Modular Monolith (Clean Architecture + DDD + CQRS)

EnableJwt.description: Enable JWT Bearer authentication. If false, only X-User-Id header is used.

ModuleName.description: Name of the first business module (default: Catalog). Use PascalCase, e.g. 'Orders' or 'Inventory'.

skipRestore.description: Skip dotnet restore after template creation.
